name: base_utils
description: Provides a common operating-system utility baseline, including Hiera-defined packages and an ERB-managed MOTD. It also includes supporting custom facts, helpers, and Bolt automation assets.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Orchestrates a Python application stack from runtime and database prerequisites through application deployment, systemd service, and monitoring. Configuration is Hiera-driven and includes Git, database, logging, backup, and health-check settings.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Installs, configures, services, and firewall-enables HAProxy with optional backend discovery. It renders multi-backend configuration from Hiera data and manages static HTTP error pages.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Configures the PGDG APT repository, installs version-specific PostgreSQL server, contrib, and client development packages, and manages the PostgreSQL service.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Deploys Redis by delegating server management to the external puppet-redis module and queries PuppetDB for nodes assigned the Redis profile.
